summary: Anthropic 发布 Claude Science，一个面向科学家的 AI 工作台，整合分散的工具和数据集，可生成图表和可视化。公司宣称 AI 有潜力“大幅加速科学发现和医疗干预开发”，并列举了多家已在使用 Claude 的生物技术和制药客户。此举标志着 Anthropic 从编程工具向生命科学领域扩展。

title: Meta's Watermelon Matches GPT-5.5 Benchmarks
raw_excerpt: Meta's superintelligence chief, Alexandr Wang, says that the company's upcoming model has caught up with OpenAI's GPT-5.5 on closely followed AI benchmarks. Codenamed Watermelon, the model is still in training. The model reportedly uses an order of magnitude more compute than Muse Spark. Meta has not given a timeline for Watermelon.
summary: Meta 超级智能负责人 Alexandr Wang 透露，代号“Watermelon”的下一代模型在基准测试中已追平 OpenAI GPT-5.5。该模型仍在训练中，据称使用了比 Muse Spark 多一个数量级的算力。Meta 尚未给出 Watermelon 的发布时间表，但这一进展表明 Meta 在 AI 竞赛中正加速追赶。

title: Introducing Laguna XS 2.1
raw_excerpt: Laguna XS 2.1 is a 33B parameter Mixture-of-Experts model optimized for agentic coding and long-horizon tasks, showing a 5.4-point improvement on SWE-bench Multilingual to 63.1%. It supports various platforms and offers three quantized checkpoints for resource-efficient deployment. Licensed under OpenMDW-1.1, it enables open model distribution and is available for download on Hugging Face or via API.
summary: Poolside 发布 Laguna XS 2.1，一个 33B 参数的混合专家模型，专为代理编码和长周期任务优化。在 SWE-bench Multilingual 上达到 63.1%，提升 5.4 个百分点。该模型支持多种平台，并提供量化版本，便于资源受限环境部署。

title: Introducing Devin Security Swarm
raw_excerpt: Devin Security Swarm is a cost-effective and accurate way to find security vulnerabilities in complex codebases. It uses a new architecture for whole-codebase reasoning called Agentic MapReduce. Devin maps relevant signals across a repository, fans out focused agents over bounded shards, reduces their findings to one report, then verifies serious vulnerabilities in isolated sandboxes before marking them confirmed. Cognition has published extensive documentation and technical materials about Agentic MapReduce.
summary: Cognition 推出 Devin Security Swarm，一种高效、低成本的安全漏洞检测方案。其核心是 Agentic MapReduce 架构，通过全代码库推理、分片代理和沙箱验证，精准发现复杂代码库中的安全漏洞。该工具已开源并附有详细技术文档。

title: Anthropic Exploring a Samsung Chip Partnership
raw_excerpt: Anthropic reportedly discussed a custom AI chip collaboration with Samsung as it looked to diversify its compute stack. The company said chips from Google, Amazon, and Nvidia remained central to its hardware strategy.
summary: Anthropic 正与三星讨论定制 AI 芯片合作，以分散其计算堆栈。Anthropic 表示，来自 Google、Amazon 和 Nvidia 的芯片仍是其硬件战略的核心。此举表明 Anthropic 在寻求更多芯片合作伙伴，以应对日益增长的算力需求。
